lede_html: Europe did the buying this week. Tenders rose from 5 to 30 on the week, nearly all of them public notices from Poland, the UK, Ireland and the Balkans, and the biggest award was Romania's US$2.2bn Cernavodă nuclear contract, which went to a Canadian-Italian-Korean consortium; the five largest awards went to Canadian, Irish, British and Indian contractors. If you sell into European power and rail, the bid calendar below is your next fortnight; if you buy, the award values are your benchmarks. On the water, Hormuz crude is back to pre-war volumes while Venezuela's barrels are being priced out by freight.

deals_why.Nuclear Power Station Construction Work: A US$2.2bn civil package for two CANDU units sets the European nuclear benchmark this year; the consortium will now place heavy civil, M&E and site-services subcontracts in Romania.
deals_why.The MaresConnect 750MW HVDC Interconnect: A US$1.1bn Ireland-Wales HVDC tender is a converter-station and subsea-cable package: the handful of HVDC suppliers will decide the price, and consortia are forming now.
deals_why.The Provision of Network Services and Wo: A US$1.0bn multi-year framework means GMC and Murphy, not the utility, will buy pipe, fittings and civils for Irish gas networks for years.
deals_why.Civil Works within NGED Substations 132k: A US$796m substation civils framework in the UK: the three named contractors are now the buyers of concrete, steelwork and site services across the NGED area.
deals_why.Rekonstrukcija i izgradnja drugog kolosi: Afcons taking a US$762m Croatian rail line is an Indian contractor winning EU-funded work; track, signalling and OHLE suppliers should expect its enquiries.
deals_why.Debr.-Ny.egyháza signaling and telecommu: Hungary's US$187m signalling and telecoms tender closes 8 October: a short window, so only bidders already qualified for Hungarian rail will make it.
deals_why.Tender for the Construction of a New Car: A US$80m cargo facility in Grand Harbour, bids due 15 October: marine civils and quay equipment for a small market where few bidders qualify.
deals_why.Railway Construction Works - Ramavtal Mi: Trafikverket's US$75m framework for smaller track works is repeat business for years rather than one job; the kind of contract regional contractors build a business on.
deals_why.Reabilitarea reţelelor de termoficare în: A US$43m district-heating rehabilitation in Constanța is pre-insulated pipe and civils; a municipal buyer, so expect EU-funding paperwork and local-content pressure.
deals_why.Kishorn Port - Phase 1B East Quay Develo: Kishorn's US$40m east quay is Scottish offshore-wind port capacity; quay construction now, fabrication and marshalling demand later.
deals_why.Modernization of Čunovo Power Plant: Slovakia's US$39m hydro modernisation is turbine, generator and control work for a state owner; a reference job for hydro OEMs in central Europe.
deals_why.Dam Construction for ПАВЕЦ 'Чаира' and R: Bulgaria's US$398m Yadenitsa dam for the Chaira pumped-storage plant is heavy civil and hydromechanical work; a national utility buyer with a long tender.

flows_why.https://oilprice.com/Energy/Crude-Oil/Ve: Freight, not supply, is cutting Venezuelan exports: buyers of heavy sour crude get steeper discounts but fewer and later cargoes.
flows_why.https://www.freightwaves.com/news/new-li: More daily slots for the largest ships means shorter queues on the US Gulf to Asia route; LNG and grain shippers should see slot premiums ease.
flows_why.https://oilprice.com/Energy/Energy-Gener: Gulf crude is flowing at the highest level since the war began: more offers for Asian refiners, even as attacks on shipping keep war-risk premiums in freight.
flows_why.https://www.hellenicshippingnews.com/cru: Crude through Hormuz is back to pre-war levels but refined products are not: product buyers east of Suez stay short while crude buyers are supplied.
flows_why.https://www.brownfieldagnews.com/market-: Wheat and corn firmed into the week's close; importers tendering this month are buying into a bounce, not a dip.
flows_why.https://www.brownfieldagnews.com/news/re: Record US cheese and butterfat exports mean more reefer demand on US export lanes and firmer dairy offers for importers into 2026.
